import sys, types, subprocess
print('python:', sys.executable)

# --- 1. Behavioral check of the fix (issue #33188 scenario) ---
import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True, APPEND_SLASH=True, ALLOWED_HOSTS=['*'])
django.setup()

from django.contrib.admin.sites import AdminSite
from django.test import RequestFactory
from django.http import HttpResponse
from django.urls import path

def dummy(request):
    return HttpResponse('ok')

m = types.ModuleType('fake_urlconf')
m.urlpatterns = [path('foo/', dummy, name='foo')]
sys.modules['fake_urlconf'] = m

site = AdminSite()
rf = RequestFactory()

# with query string (the reported bug)
r = rf.get('/foo', {'id': '123'})
r.urlconf = m
resp = site.catch_all_view(r, 'foo')
print('with query string ->', resp.status_code, resp['Location'])

# without query string (must stay clean, no stray '?')
r2 = rf.get('/foo')
r2.urlconf = m
resp2 = site.catch_all_view(r2, 'foo')
print('no query string   ->', resp2.status_code, resp2['Location'])

# multiple params keep order/encoding
r3 = rf.get('/foo', {'id': '123', 'q': 'a b'})
r3.urlconf = m
resp3 = site.catch_all_view(r3, 'foo')
print('multi params      ->', resp3.status_code, resp3['Location'])

# --- 2. Existing catch-all test class via the project's own runner ---
p = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, 'tests/runtests.py',
     'admin_views.tests.AdminSiteFinalCatchAllPatternTests', '-v', '1'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=280,
)
print('--- runtests exit:', p.returncode, '---')
print(p.stdout[-2500:])
if p.returncode != 0:
    print('STDERR:', p.stderr[-2000:])
